core_obligations: Statement (lines 419-423): for a differential graded algebra (A, d), the category Mod_(A,d) of differential graded A-modules is abelian and has arbitrary limits and colimits.

Creation of kernels, cokernels, sums and colimits (proof lines 425-429): kernels and cokernels commute with taking underlying A-modules, as do direct sums and colimits; in other words these operations commute with the forgetful functor, so the abelian structure and small colimits are created by the forgetful functor (kernels are equalizers, so equalizers are covered as well).

Product formula (lines 429-435): the product of a family N_i in Mod_(A,d) is given degree-wise by (prod N_i)^n = prod N_i^n with total object the direct sum over degrees of these; thus products commute with the forgetful functor to graded A-modules.
Limits criterion (lines 435-437): a category with products and equalizers has all limits, by the Categories lemma.
proof_roadmap: Transfer the abelian structure and colimits through the forgetful functor.
Compute products degree-wise with direct-sum totalization.
Conclude all limits exist from the products-and-equalizers criterion.
